extracted.intended_audience: homeowners and renters shopping for a home security system / consumers evaluating SimpliSafe
extracted.subtask_description: Marketing/product landing page describing SimpliSafe home security features, guarantees, monitoring plans, and installation/coverage options for prospective customers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Built for security. Not surveillance.
rubrics_metrics.description: Built for security. Not surveillance. SimpliSafe® delivers advanced, whole home security, plus gives you control of your personal information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioning claim emphasizing privacy-first design and control over personal information; used as an evaluative promise rather than a technical specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24/7 professional monitoring
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Continuous professional monitoring available; requires a monitoring plan. Promotional notes include 'Your first month of professional monitoring is free.' See footnote: cellular backup available with professional monitoring plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Active Guard Outdoor Protection (AI-powered outdoor cameras + live agents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Active Guard Outdoor Protection. AI-powered outdoor cameras and live agents work together to help prevent crime before it happens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workflow described: AI-powered camera alerts monitoring center; in less than 30 sec an agent can assess and react; agents can speak, sound siren, trigger spotlight, and request priority police dispatch with video verification. Requires a monitoring plan with SimpliSafe® Active Guard Outdoor Protection and an Outdoor Camera (Series 2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agents can request priority police dispatch with video verification
rubrics_metrics.description: Agents can also request priority police dispatch with video verification of a crime in progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This capability is tied to Active Guard and verified alarms. It implies faster/verified dispatch but is contingent on device type, monitoring plan, and local agency policies (disclaimers apply).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobile app control & smart home integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Mobile app control & smart home integration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can control system and view camera recordings via the SimpliSafe app. Notifications and live feeds available; app is central to user control and reviewing recordings. Some features require select monitoring plans and system to be armed during plan hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unlimited camera recordings & 30-day cloud storage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: **Applies for up to 10 cameras and requires a monitoring plan with camera recordings. Noted limits and plan requirements: 'For up to 10 cameras. Monitoring plan with camera recordings required.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Up to 24-hour battery backup, Wi‑Fi, and cellular connection
rubrics_metrics.description: Up to 24-hour battery backup, Wi-Fi, and cellular connection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Connectivity redundancy and backup power are offered; cellular backup is available with professional monitoring plans (footnote). This is presented as part of system reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated privacy shutter on all indoor cameras
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrated privacy shutter on all indoor cameras
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hardware privacy feature that allows users to physically block camera view when desired; reinforces privacy-focused marketing claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anti-Theft Guarantee (insurance deductible assistance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Get up to $500 toward your insurance deductible with Anti-Theft Guarantee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anti-Theft Guarantee helps cover loss or damage from break-ins. Footnote: 'With select professional monitoring plans.' Check terms for eligibility and claim conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lifetime warranty and 10% discount on hardware for subscribers
rubrics_metrics.description: Lifetime warranty and 10% discount on hardware included for subscribers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes subscriber benefits; 'With select professional monitoring plans.' Users should confirm which plans include these benefits and any limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: No long-term contracts or hidden fees (cancel anytime)
rubrics_metrics.description: No contracts. No cancellation fees. No kidding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marketing claim that customers may cancel without penalty. Note: an exception is noted elsewhere: 'Contract required for ADT Pro Installed.' Users should verify terms for install types and promotions.

rubrics_metrics.name: First month of professional monitoring is free
rubrics_metrics.description: Your first month of professional monitoring is free
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotional offer for new monitoring subscriptions; follow-up billing and plan terms will apply after trial month.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indoor camera real-time intervention
rubrics_metrics.description: Agents can use the Indoor Camera to help stop crime in real time
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires a Smart Alarm Indoor Camera with select professional monitoring plans (footnote). Indicates agents can intervene via indoor camera feed when eligible under plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer ratings and industry awards as quality signals
rubrics_metrics.description: Ratings and awards: '4.8 • 300K Ratings (as of 6/24)', 'US News "Best Home Security Systems" 5/6 Years Running', 'America’s Best Customer Service', 'America’s Customer Service Champions'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as social proof and external validation to help consumers evaluate trustworthiness and service quality; consumers should consider sources, dates, and methodology behind awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: DIY ease and Pro Install option
rubrics_metrics.description: Easiest. Thing. I. Have. Ever. Installed. / See if Pro Install is right for you
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims DIY installation simplicity via testimonials and offers professional installation as an option. Consumers should choose based on comfort with DIY versus desire for professional setup; Pro Install may require contracts or different terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Try it. Test it. Love it or return it. (trial/return policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Try it. Test it. Love it or return it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates a guarantee/return policy allowing returns if unsatisfied; consumers should review full return terms, time limits, and any restocking/return shipping conditions.
